Description: "Normalize restored pre-order items when selecting temporary tables to avoid NaN calculations and blank names."
Instruction: "Normalize poItems properties before setting to cart in selectPosTable"
ReplacementContent:
"        const poItems = (Array.isArray(poData.items) 
          ? poData.items 
          : (typeof poData.items === 'string' ? JSON.parse(poData.items) : []))
          .map(i => ({
            ...i,
            product_name: i.product_name || i.name || 'Item',
            name: i.name || i.product_name || 'Item',
            quantity: parseInt(i.quantity || i.qty || 1, 10),
            qty: parseInt(i.qty || i.quantity || 1, 10),
            price: parseFloat(i.price) || 0,
            modifiers: i.modifiers || [],
            kot_category: i.kot_category || 'Main Kitchen'
          }));
        setCart(poItems);"
